messages:
maya: Heads-up: EU DSAR arrived referencing an active vuln. Legal asks for export + possible hold for forensics. Can we do a minimal RBAC + KMS flow to export only that user's artifacts?
jamal: yes, ops can do a scoped export. prefer ephemeral role with kms:Decrypt only for specific key ARN and PutObject to quarantine bucket. auto-revoke after 24h.
eli: note: don't change key policies. create an IAM role that assumes and uses a narrow inline policy. add aws:RequestTag/erasure-case for traceability.
tara-privacy: we need chain-of-custody: who, when, keys, and an approver. If legal requests hold, file a retention-exception and list CISO as approver.
ciso: I can approve a 48h hold if artifacts are immutable and not re-ingested. Post the policy + where CloudTrail will export evidence.
security-bot: [INCIDENT] 2026-4291 created: vuln-ceres -> related DSAR 2026-ER-91.
maya: draft policy (sanity check): `{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Action":"kms:Decrypt","Resource":"arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123456:key/uv-*"},{"Effect":"Allow","Action":["s3:PutObject"],"Resource":"arn:aws:s3:::privacy-quarantine/er-91/*"}]}`
jamal: running assume-role then `aws s3 cp /tmp/export.tgz s3://privacy-quarantine/er-91/export.tgz --tagging "erasure-case=er-91"`. will paste audit meta after upload.
eli: ensure CloudTrail events forwarded to evidence-lockbox and mark objects with Object Lock GOVERNANCE for the hold period.
tara-privacy: received artifact link, opening retention-exception RE-534 and tagging @ciso. need timestamps and user list for ticket.
ciso: reviewed logs, approving RE-534 for 48h. Conditions: no re-ingest, export immutable, revoke role at expiry.
maya: action items: jamal run export & paste manifest, eli confirm no wide key changes, tara file RE-534. I'll attach this thread to the incident. :lock:
